1.text: Izahabu ko yafutukuye,Izahabu nziza cyane ko yahindutse,Amabuye y'ubuturo bwera yanyanyagijwe mu mahuriro y'inzira zose!

2.text: Abahungu b'ibikundiro b'i Siyoni,Bari bameze nk'izahabu nziza,Ko bagereranijwe nk'ibibindi bibumbwa,Umurimo w'amaboko y'umubumbyi!

3.text: Ndetse imbwebwe na zo ziha ibibwana byazo amabwabwa ngo zibyonse.Umukobwa w'ubwoko bwanjye yahindutse inkazi,Nk'imbuni zo mu butayu.

4.text: Ururimi rw'umwana wonka,Rufata mu rusenge rw'akanwa ruguye ubuga.Abana bato baragabuza,Ariko nta muntu ubagaburira.

5.text: Abasanzwe bafungura bitonze bihebeye mu nzira,Abarerewe mu mihemba barambaraye ku macukiro.

6.text: Kuko igicumuro cy'umukobwa w'ubwoko bwanjye,Kirusha icyaha cy'i Sodomu gukomera.Ni ho hubamye mu kanya,Kandi nta maboko ahakozeho.

7.text: Imfura ze zari ziboneye kuruta shelegi,Zarushaga amata kwera.Zari zikeye mu maso kurusha amabuye ya marijani,Zarabagiranaga nka safiro.

8.text: Mu maso habo hahindutse imbyiro kurusha umukara,Ntibakimenyekana mu nzira.Umubiri wabo wumatanye n'amagufwa yabo,Warumye wabaye nk'igiti.

9.text: Abicwa n'inkota bapfa neza kuruta abicwa n'inzara,Kuko bo bapfa urupfu n'agashinyaguro,Babitewe no kubura umwero w'imirima.

10.text: Abagore b'imbabazi bafashe abana bibyariye,Barabateka baba ibyokurya byabo,Igihe umukobwa w'ubwoko bwanjye arimbutse.

11.text: Uwiteka yashohoje uburakari bwe,Yasutse umujinya we ukaze,Kandi yakongeje umuriro muri Siyoni,Utwika imfatiro zaho.

12.text: Abami bo mu isi n'abatuye mu isi bose,Ntabwo bibwiraga ko ababisha n'abanzi,Batwaranira mu marembo y'i Yerusalemu.

13.text: Ibyaha by'abahanuzi baho,N'ibicumuro by'abatambyi baho,Basheshe amaraso y'abakiranutsi muri yo,Ibyo ni byo byabiteye.

14.text: Barindagira mu nzira nk'impumyi,Biyanduje amaraso,Bituma abantu badatinyuka gukora ku myambaro yabo.

15.text: Barabamagana bati“Nimugende mwa bahumanye mwe,Nimuhave, nimuhave ntimugire icyo mukoraho.”Igihe bahungaga bateraganwa,Abo mu banyamahanga baravugaga bati“Ntibazongera gutura hano ukundi.”

16.text: Uburakari bw'Uwiteka bwarabatatanije,Ntazasubira kubitaho.Ntibitaye ku batambyi,Ntibasonera n'abasaza.

17.text: Amaso yacu arembejwe no gutegereza gutabarwa kwacu,Kandi ari iby'ubusa.Ubwo twategerezaga,Twategereje ubwoko butabasha kudukiza.

18.text: Baratwubikiye,Bituma tutabasha kunyura mu mayira yacu.Iherezo ryacu riri hafi,Iminsi yacu irashize,Kuko iherezo ryacu rigeze.

19.text: Abatwirukana barusha ibisiga byo mu kirere imbaraga,Batwirukanye ku misozi miremire,No mu butayu bakaducira igico.

20.text: Uwatumaga duhumeka ari we wasīzwe n'Uwiteka,Yafatiwe mu myobo yabo,Kandi ari we twari twizeranye, tuti“Mu gicucu cye ni ho tuzatura,Dukikijwe n'abanyamahanga.”

21.text: Ishime kandi unezerwe, mukobwa wa Edomu we,Utuye mu gihugu cyo muri Usi.Nawe igikombe kizahita kikugeraho,Uzasinda wiyambike ubusa.

22.text: Igihano cy'igicumuro cyawe kirarangiye,Yewe mukobwa w'i Siyoni we,Ntazongera kukujyana kure uri imbohe.Yewe mukobwa wa Edomu we,Azaguhanira igicumuro cyawe,Azatwikurura ibyaha byawe.
